title: Find both ends of a fixed array
prompt: Return the smallest and largest values in a four-element std::array, in that order. Values may all be negative. Do not mutate the caller’s array.

tests.label: All negative
tests.hint: Initialize both candidates from a real element.

tests.label: All positive
tests.hint: Zero is not necessarily an array element.

hints: A std::array<int,4> always has four elements.
Use values[0] as the first candidate because an empty case is impossible.
explanation: The min and max candidates are always values seen so far. The pair groups the two answers without changing input.
